_readme: Searchable places. Edit freely. popular: shown as chips on the search screen, in 'popularOrder'. floor: MazeMap level number, or null for a whole building. mazemapPoi: optional MazeMap POI id. Coordinates: WGS84 (check with a GPS walk before real use).

destinations.name: Library
destinations.description: Study spaces, group rooms, computers and printing.

destinations.name: Atrium
destinations.description: The heart of campus: student services, cafés and shops.

destinations.name: Cottrell Building
destinations.description: The main teaching building, with lecture theatres and seminar rooms.

destinations.name: Pathfoot Building

destinations.description: Gym, sports halls and the National Swimming Academy pool.

destinations.name: Campus Central
destinations.description: The central hub linking the Atrium, the Library and the Students' Union.

destinations.name: Logie Lecture Theatre
destinations.description: One of the largest lecture theatres on campus.

destinations.name: Macrobert Arts Centre
destinations.description: Cinema, theatre and gallery, open to everyone.

destinations.name: Iris Murdoch Building
destinations.description: Home to the Dementia Services Development Centre.

destinations.name: Andrew Stewart Hall
